# AMC Neo Brutal

<!-- Generated by tools/build-styles.mjs from style.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Universal Theme style** · light · built on vita · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A bold neo-brutalist style: ink borders, hard offset shadows, flat saturated fills, a sun-yellow header, pink and lime accents and a strong cobalt primary, with calm report rows for daily data entry.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x:** Shared Components > Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_style_neo_brutal.sql`
  (Component Export) into an app on Universal Theme. It adds the style to Theme 42 and uploads
  `amc-styles/amc-style-neo-brutal.css` as a Static Application File. Then pick it in Theme Roller or
  Shared Components > Themes > Universal Theme > Styles (Set as Current), or let users pick it when
  Customization is enabled.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/styles/amc-neo-brutal.apx` and the static file, merge
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx`, and set `style.currentThemeStyle` in `theme.apx` to
  `@amc-neo-brutal` if it should be the default. Then run the apexlang gates.

Light style built on Vita. Regions, buttons and fields get 2px ink borders and hard offset shadows (mirrored in right-to-left pages); buttons press down on click, without animation when the user prefers reduced motion. The header is sun yellow with ink text, the current menu entry is pink, and the primary color is a cobalt blue that passes WCAG AA with white text. Report rows keep light dividers so dense data stays readable. Works with every AMC component and template, which read the same --ut-* variables. Refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page.
